metadata.notes: DeepSeek Harness persists one assistant message per JSONL row; a tokenizer-efficient 10199-character payload gives this cell a deterministic 300-second recipe after two 900-second 5000-token attempts timed out.

assessment.body:
## Verdict

agent_supports: yes
daemon_capability: full
driver_capability: ready

## Agent support

DeepSeek Harness 0.1.5-rc.2 can emit the required single-record payload. The agent loop collects streamed blocks without a text-size truncation step and appends the settled content as one assistant/message event. The official JSONL persistence backend serializes each current event through JSON.stringify and stores one physical row per durable event inside a checksummed Zstandard frame.

Two live attempts showed that the prior 5000-repeat recipe was not bounded on this local route. Both 900-second runs reached ready to working, stayed alive with 15 durable events, and timed out before an assistant/message or completed turn/end appeared. This is evidence against that recipe budget. It is not evidence that the agent cannot emit a large row.

The revised recipe requests dequeueReusableCellWithIdentifier exactly 300 times with one space between literals. The installed Qwen3.5 tokenizer maps every space-prefixed repetition to token 70331. The resulting text is 10199 characters and needs about 305 output tokens, rather than about 5000. This line is larger than the 3851-byte pi, 8477-byte antigravity, and 9817-byte gemini-cli recorded sibling maxima. The exact transcript assertion rejects a short reply, refusal, partial generation, or tool-based substitute.

## Daemon capability

The DSH adapter watches the highest session.vN.jsonl.zstd generation through FilesUnderRoot and JSONLineParser. The shared tailer validates each complete Zstandard frame, caps decoded frames at 256 MB, and passes decoded bytes through the 64 MB line reader. The second failed staging transcript contains a 27557-byte request/header row followed by later rows, and irrlichd processed the batch into the expected ready to working transition. This live evidence confirms that the transport does not stall on a line larger than the revised 10199-character assistant payload. A future recording must still prove the completed assistant row and ready return.

This cell remains a parser-resilience sanity check. It is not a cap-stress test. The unit fixture owns the multi-megabyte regression.

## Driver capability and timing

The recipe needs send, wait_turn, and sleep. The DeepSeek Harness interactive driver implements all three. It creates a fresh cwd, applies the fixed LM Studio model patch, resolves only a post-marker transcript with the same cwd, and waits for a durable turn/end record. The final 8-second sleep matches the longest sibling delay. The 300-second timeout matches the longest normal sibling budget and is proportionate to the approximately 305-token response.

## Vacuous-pass check

The lifecycle phases alone could pass after a short answer and would prove nothing about a large row. The exact 10199-character assistant substring, the single assistant record, and the zero-tool assertion are load-bearing. The fresh cwd and marker are also load-bearing because they prevent an older DSH session from satisfying the phase chain. LM Studio must expose qwen/qwen3.5-9b and permit at least about 305 output tokens.
caveats: Emission remains provisional until record drives the exact 300-repeat request. Source and tokenizer evidence prove the bounded target and one-row persistence, but the live LM Studio server can still fail. The exact transcript assertion makes that failure loud.

Vacuous-pass condition: lifecycle-only matching would pass on a short answer. The spec therefore requires the complete 10199-character repeated-literal payload in one assistant/message record and requires zero tool/call records.

Load-bearing environment precondition: LM Studio must serve qwen/qwen3.5-9b at http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1 and permit about 305 output tokens. The model roster was re-probed during reassessment, but record must re-probe it.

Two live 900-second attempts with the old 5000-repeat prompt timed out in working at 15 durable events and no assistant/message or completed turn/end. The cause is inferred to be excessive generation time because the TUI and model route stayed alive; the evidence does not prove the internal model state.
This is a roughly 10 KB sanity check. It does not exercise the 64 MB line cap or the 256 MB decoded-frame cap. core/pkg/tailer/large_line_test.go owns the true large-line regression.

The revised payload exceeds the committed pi, antigravity, and gemini-cli sibling maximum transcript line sizes, but scenario 2.16 remains below the historical Scanner limit across all of these live fixtures.
The fixed qwen model has used reasoning at content index 0 and text at index 1 in the measured local corpus. The assertion pins index 1; a provider-shape change must fail loudly and be reassessed.

sources.note: Installed official runtime sets DEFAULT_MAX_TOKENS to 32768 and uses that default for a hand-declared provider model when no smaller model limit is configured.
The loop collects live.blocks and appends the settled result as assistant/message with the original content and usage.
Official installed package reference states that the current format stores one physical row per durable event and uses checksummed Zstandard frames by default.
eventLine calls JSON.stringify on one current event; eventLines joins events with newline separators; encodeEventBatch compresses the complete JSONL batch without content truncation.
Measured qwen/qwen3.5-9b v3 transcript. Assistant records use reasoning at content index 0, text at index 1, non-zero usage, and a following completed turn/end.
Declares the compressed FilesUnderRoot source with JSONLineParser for DeepSeek Harness.
Maps turn/start to working, assistant/message text and usage, and completed turn/end to the ready boundary.
Validates complete Zstandard frames, caps decoded frames at four times the 64 MB line limit, and scans decoded bytes through the shared line reader.
Defines the 64 MB JSONL line cap and skip-past behavior that prevents an oversized row from wedging later records.
Regression fixture proves a multi-megabyte JSONL row does not block a later turn_done event and pins over-cap skip behavior.
Implements send, wait_turn, and sleep; applies the fixed LM Studio patch and resolves a readable post-marker transcript for the fresh run cwd.
Sibling scenario precedent uses a 5000-word single-line response and treats the live cell as a parser-resilience sanity check.
Installed model tokenizer maps the space-prefixed literal dequeueReusableCellWithIdentifier to one token, ID 70331.
First live attempt records driver_exit_reason timeout after the 900-second 5000-repeat recipe.
Second live attempt records driver_exit_reason timeout after the same 900-second recipe.
Second attempt has 15 events, ready to working, 898583 ms in working, then process exit without ready return.
Committed observed sibling has an 8477-byte maximum transcript line.

Committed observed sibling has a 3851-byte maximum transcript line.

preconditions: dsh >=0.1.5-rc.2 is installed and on PATH
the community TUI profile is installed under ~/.dsh/profiles/tui
LM Studio is listening at http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1 with qwen/qwen3.5-9b loaded and permits about 305 output tokens; re-probe the model at record time
irrlichd is recording the deepseek-harness adapter with transcript permission granted
setup: The interactive driver creates a fresh cwd under the staging directory and launches dsh --profile tui in tmux.
The driver applies a temporary patch that selects LM Studio and qwen/qwen3.5-9b without modifying the installed TUI profile.
The driver resolves the new session.v3.jsonl.zstd by pre-launch marker, header cwd, and parent session ID, then waits for the expected completed turn/end count.
DSH persists the complete assistant/message event as one JSONL row inside a checksummed Zstandard frame.

script.text: Output the exact literal dequeueReusableCellWithIdentifier exactly 300 times, separated by one ASCII space. Output no other text. Do not use tools. Do not use line breaks.

verify: events.jsonl contains one post-marker DSH UUID session born ready and bound to the session.lock writer PID
the same session enters working after the real user message and returns to ready after completed turn/end without entering waiting
transcript.jsonl contains exactly one assistant/message whose text block contains the complete 10199-character 300-repeat payload on that single durable record
transcript.jsonl contains no tool/call record and exactly one completed turn/end
the replay summary reports qwen/qwen3.5-9b and non-zero tokens; cost remains zero for the local LM Studio route
recipe.scope_note: Uses the longest sibling post-turn settle delay of 8 seconds and the longest normal sibling turn budget of 300 seconds. The local tokenizer makes 299 of the 300 space-prefixed literals one token each, so this 10199-character payload needs about 305 output tokens instead of about 5000.
